body.p: Application Ser. No. 17/926364 Attorney Docket No. 4015-11847 Client Docket No. P080386US01 REMARKS
Claims 33 and 51-52 are amended in this response. Claims 36-37 are cancelled without prejudice. No new matter has been added. 35 U.S.C. & 103 Rejections
Independent claims 33 and 51-52 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being
unpatentable over "Koubaa" (NPL entitled "ROSLink: Bridging ROS-with the Internet-of-Things for Cloud Robotics") in view of "Racz" (U.S. Pub. No. 2022/0219322). Office Action, p.
2. However, dependent claims 37, 39-43, 45, and 50 are indicated as reciting patentable subject matter.
Accordingly, solely to advance prosecution and obtain a patent grant, Applicant has

amended independent claim 33 to incorporate the limitations of allowed claim 37, and to correct a minor informality not noted in the Office Action. Independent claims 51 and 52 have been similarly amended. Regarding the dependent claims, they are all allowable over the art of record due at least to their dependencies on a respective one of the amended independent claims. Conclusion
In light of the foregoing amendments and their corresponding remarks, Applicant
submits that all pending claims are in condition for allowance, and respectfully requests that the Office issue a notice to such effect at its earliest convenience.
